This page details the installation and usage of the Python version of the PropLib implementation of the IF-77 Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Model.

{{< include /includes/_link_to_model_home.qmd >}}

{{< include /includes/python/_getting_started.qmd >}}

### Installation

This Python package is distributed through the
[Python Package Index (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/proplib-if77).
Run the following command to install the package, and any required dependencies, into your Python environment.

```default
pip install proplib-if77
```

The following code snippet shows how to import the package and check the installed version.

```python
from ITS.Propagation import IF77
print(IF77.__version__)
```

{{< include /includes/python/_uninstallation.qmd >}}

```default
pip uninstall proplib-if77
```

{{< include /includes/python/_documentation.qmd >}}

```python
help(IF77.IF77)
```

## Examples

The following code examples show how the IF77 model can be called from Python.

### Calling the IF77 Model

```python
from ITS.Propagation import IF77

# define inputs
card1 = IF77.Card1
card2 = IF77.Card2
card3 = IF77.Card3

card1.output_type = IF77.OutputType.TransmissionLoss
card1.lobing_flag = IF77.Lobing.NoLobing
card1.time_availability_flag = IF77.TimeAvailability.InstantaneousLevels
card1.d__km = 119.3048129015685
card1.percentage = 50.

card2.h_1__meter = 292.10976985787516
card2.antenna_1_pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic
card2.antenna_1_use = IF77.AntennaUse.Directive
card2.antenna_1_polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical
card2.antenna_1_tilt__deg = 0
card2.antenna_1_half_half_beamwidth__deg = 0
card2.h_fss__meter = 242.10976985787516
card2.rainfall_zone = IF77.RainfallZone.NoRainfall
card2.storm_size = IF77.StormSize.FiveKm
card2.terrain_type = IF77.TerrainType.IrregularTerrain
card2.horizon_input = IF77.HorizonInput.Height
card2.delta_h__meter = 290.8360817429317
card2.d_hzn__km = 5.8102343919372412
card2.h_hzn__meter = 471
card2.low_horizon_angle_degrees = 1
card2.low_horizon_angle_minutes = 44
card2.low_horizon_angle_seconds = 27
card2.counterpoise_diameter__meter = 0
card2.counterpoise_height__meter = 0
card2.counterpoise_material = IF77.Material.None

card3.h_2__meter = 120000
card3.antenna_2_pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic
card3.antenna_2_use = IF77.AntennaUse.Directive
card3.antenna_2_polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical
card3.antenna_2_tilt__deg = 0
card3.antenna_2_half_half_beamwidth__deg = 0
card3.N_0 = 315
card3.f__mhz = 3000
card3.eirp = 0
card3.h_sur__meter = 284
card3.path_material = IF77.Material.AverageGround
card3.water_temp__celsius = IF77.Temperature.TenDegreesCelsius
card3.water_wave_height = 0
card3.water_state = IF77.WaterState.CalmGlassy
card3.path_water_wave_height_use_flag = IF77.WaterWaveHeight.UseStandard
card3.scintillation_index_group = IF77.ScintillationIndex.IndexGroup1
card3.scintillation_freq_scaling = IF77.FrequencyScaling.None
card3.scintillation_use_flag = IF77.ScintillationUse.NoScintillation
card3.climate_1 = IF77.Climate.ContinentalAllYear
card3.weight_1 = 0
card3.climate_2 = IF77.Climate.ContinentalAllYear
card3.weight_2 = 0

# Call the IF77 model
result = IF77.IF77(card1, card2, card3)

# The result is a data structure containing five elements:
# result.warnings                 is 0
# result.takeoff_angle__degrees   is approximately  85.63319
# result.propagation_mode         is ITS.Propagation.IF77.PropagationMode.LightOfSight (PropagationMode enum value 1)
# result.A_fs__db                 is approximately  102.54639
# result.A__db                    is approximately  -102.54841
```

### Calling the IF77 Extended Model.

The inputs for IF77 Extended Model are the same as IF77 Model shown above. The outputs include the terminals and path information in addition to IF77 model results.

```python
from ITS.Propagation import IF77

# Call the IF77 extended model
result, terminal1, terminal2, path = IF77.IF77Ex(card1, card2, card3)

# The terminal1 and terminal2 are data structure containing terminal information
# The path is data structure containing path information
```
